issue.title: [Bug] Claude Desktop Credentials Test 被误判为标题请求，命中已关闭 provider
issue.body:
## 问题描述

Claude Desktop 已接入 Magpie 本地网关。`GET /v1/models` 可以成功返回当前启用供应商的模型，但 **Gateway credentials → Test connection** 会失败，并错误提示另一个已经关闭的供应商不可用。

当前现场：

- Claude Desktop gateway：`http://127.0.0.1:3425`
- 当前启用供应商：`My Claude`
- 之前使用、现已关闭的供应商：`Any`
- `~/.config/magpie/claude-desktop.model` 仍保存：`any/claude-fable-5-1-reversed`
- 复现基线：`main@674b6ca2881f1289c4ccdec158762978a463320c`

## 复现步骤

1. 让 Claude Desktop 通过 Magpie 使用供应商 A 的模型，并运行一次会话。
2. 在 Magpie 中关闭供应商 A。
3. 保持供应商 B 开启，并让 Claude Desktop 能看到其模型。
4. 打开 **Developer → Configure Third-Party Inference**。
5. Models 连接测试成功，可以列出供应商 B 的模型。
6. 执行 **Gateway credentials → Test connection**。

实际结果：

```text
HTTP 404
Any is switched off in Magpie, so "my-claude/claude-sonnet-5-5" is not served; switch it on again in Magpie's Providers to use it
```

预期结果：Credentials Test 应测试当前配置发现或指定的模型，不应被旧会话中已关闭供应商的模型替换。

## 现场证据

当前 Claude Desktop 的 gateway health probe 是一个无 tools 的 1-token Anthropic Messages 请求：

```json
{
  "model": "<discovered model>",
  "max_tokens": 1,
  "messages": [
    {"role": "user", "content": "."}
  ]
}
```

本机验证结果：

- 使用当前 credential 请求 `/v1/models` 返回 HTTP 200，并列出 `My Claude` 模型。
- 按 Claude Desktop 的 1-token probe 请求 `/v1/messages`，返回 HTTP 404，并错误指向已关闭的 `Any`。
- 直接使用 canonical ID `my-claude/claude-sonnet-5-5` 进行同样 probe，仍得到相同 Any 错误。
- 持久化文件 `claude-desktop.model` 中正是旧 Any 模型。

## 根因

当前 [`internal/gateway/desktop.go`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/674b6ca2881f1289c4ccdec158762978a463320c/internal/gateway/desktop.go#L457-L485) 中，`desktopTurn` 会把 Electron 发来的“无 tools、小输出、Claude-looking model”请求当成 Desktop 标题请求：

```go
aside := small(body)
if byClaudeCode {
    aside = desktopTitle(body)
}
title := !tools && aside && desktopAccepts(asked)
```

`small(body)` 接受所有 `max_tokens <= 4096` 的请求。Credentials Test 恰好是 `max_tokens: 1`、无 tools、模型名看起来像 Claude，因此被误判成标题请求。随后 `desktopTurn` 使用 `claude-desktop.model` 中的旧会话模型替换当前 probe model，最终在 `provider.SwitchedOff` 处得到 Any 404。

这也解释了为什么 Models 测试成功，而 Credentials Test 失败：模型发现不经过 `desktopTurn`，推理 probe 会经过。

## 建议修复

使用已有的 `desktopTitle(body)` 对标题请求做正向识别，不再根据 `max_tokens` 猜测：

```go
title := !tools && desktopTitle(body) && desktopAccepts(asked)
```

`desktopTitle` 已支持 Desktop 的字符串 system prompt 和 Claude Code 的 system text blocks。真实标题请求仍会跟随会话模型；Credentials Test、分类器和其他小请求继续使用它们明确指定的模型。

此后 `desktopTurn` 的 `byClaudeCode` 参数也不再需要，可以移除。本改动不增加网络、credential 或 provider 行为。

## 回归测试

已编写一个不访问网络的回归测试：

- `old/claude-fable-5-1`：已关闭，并保存在 `claude-desktop.model`
- `current/claude-sonnet-5-5`：已启用，由 1-token credential probe 指定

修复前：

```text
--- FAIL: TestClaudeDesktopCredentialProbeKeepsItsModel
credential probe sent "old/claude-fable-5-1", want "current/claude-sonnet-5-5"
FAIL github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/gateway
```

修复后目标测试通过；以下相邻测试也通过：

```text
TestClaudeDesktopAuxiliaryModel
TestClaudeDesktopDefault
TestClaudeDesktopClassifierKeepsItsModel
TestClaudeDesktopCredentialProbeKeepsItsModel
TestDesktopTitle
```

接这单（hunt30 审计车道）。已在 main@7597c132 上核实根因：`desktopTurn` 的 `small(body)` 只看 `max_tokens <= 4096`，Desktop 的健康探测（max_tokens 1、无 tools、claude 形模型名）被当标题请求，带去 `claude-desktop.model` 里的旧会话模型，404。修法照报告里说的正向识别 `desktopTitle(body)`，`byClaudeCode` 参数随之冗余移除。补丁稍后贴在本 issue，分支：`hunt30-desktop-title`（fork ggbdpq/magpie）。

Generated-by: GLM-5.3-Flash (ZCode)

照报告的根因修了，红绿与消融都在 main@7597c132 上做过：

- `desktopTurn` 不再拿 `max_tokens <= 4096` 当标题（`small`），改用 `desktopTitle(body)` 的正向识别：标题 prompt 的两种形状（Desktop 自有客户端的字符串 system、Claude Code `--system-prompt` 的 text block）都已在 `desktopTitle` 里。其余无 tools 的请求一律保留自己点名的模型——Claude Code 的分类器本来就是这个行为（#1539），Desktop 的探测现在也是。`byClaudeCode` 参数因此冗余，随补丁移除；`small()` 保留（observe.go 还在用）。
- 回归 `TestDesktopProbeKeepsItsModel`：探测打在被服务的模型上、`claude-desktop.model` 里留着已关供应商的 pick——修前 404（"Any is switched off in Magpie, so \"fake/claude-sonnet-5\" is not served; switch it on again…"，与报告同形），修后探测用自己的模型、不写 pick；标题仍跟随会话 pick。

| go test ./internal/gateway 全量（-tags nogui -p 2 -timeout 45m） | ok，303.5s |
| gofmt -l internal/ | 干净 |
| go vet ./...（darwin / GOOS=linux -tags nogui / GOOS=windows） | 干净（trayimage_darwin 的 cgo -Wenum-conversion 警告为本机已知环境噪音） |
| go build（darwin / linux nogui / windows） | ok |

Claude Desktop probes the gateway it is given before saving its
credentials: a one-token request, no tools, a model from /v1/models.
desktopTurn judged a tool-less request a session title by max_tokens
alone (small: at most 4096), so the probe went to the session's pick —
one a previous session left on a provider since switched off, and the
test came back "… is switched off in Magpie, so … is not served" naming
that provider, however healthy the model the probe asked for (#2473,
EchoTint). Models discovery answered fine, which made it look like the
credentials were at fault.

What changed:
- desktop.go: a title is the request whose system prompt is Desktop's
  title prompt (desktopTitle), whoever sent it — Desktop's own client,
  or Claude Code's `claude -p --system-prompt …` for it. Every other
  tool-less request keeps the model it names: Claude Code's classifiers

desktop family (TestDesktop*, TestClaudeDesktop*, TestHasTools): ok.

Reproduced the stale-provider part of this issue on macOS with packaged Magpie 0.1.1296 and Claude Desktop 2.42304.2.

In this case provider A was still enabled globally, but Claude Desktop had been restricted to provider B. `GET /v1/models` correctly listed only B. `claude-desktop.model` still contained an A model, and the Desktop startup probe for B's Haiku alias was sent to A's Opus model. The returned 502 named A. The gateway usage record confirmed `req=B/claude-haiku-5-5`, `provider=A`, `model=claude-opus-5-5`.

The caller was Claude Desktop and the probe body was:

```json
{"model":"<B's Haiku alias>","max_tokens":1,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"."}]}
```

So validation against the globally enabled providers alone is not sufficient: a cached pick can also be outside the current Desktop-visible catalog. An explicit connection probe should retain its selected provider/model and should not mutate the session's pick. This supports the positive title-prompt identification fix proposed above.

Separately, this environment also has a credential-specific upstream refusal of raw HTTP probes. Replaying that same minimal request directly to the configured upstream, bypassing Magpie, returns 429, while a genuine Claude Code invocation through the identical proxy and credential succeeds. That is a separate compatibility problem, not evidence that the stale-provider routing fix failed. No credentials, prompts from real work, proxy authentication details, or account identifiers are included here.

Gentle nudge on this one — no rush. The fix (branch `hunt30-desktop-title`, head 910522a7) still applies cleanly to current main. Since it was posted, SivanCola reproduced the stale-provider half of the report on macOS with packaged Magpie 0.1.1296 and Claude Desktop 2.42304.2, which lands right on the behavior this addresses: the title probe went to a provider a previous session had left behind instead of the model it was asked about, so `desktopTurn` now recognizes the title prompt by its shape instead of trusting `max_tokens`. Happy to adjust if anything is missing.

Nudged with AI assistance (GLM-5.3-Flash via ZCode).

Published a fix in my fork: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/9fd7a9d4c087d3c0f4caac1ff3d27a8350577744

Thanks to @ggbdpq for the diagnosis and posted fix above, credited as co-author. Desktop titles now use the existing positive system-prompt check (`desktopTitle`) for both Electron and Claude Code. A small max_tokens alone no longer reroutes a credential probe to the saved session model. The unused client-kind argument is removed from desktopTurn and all callers, and the routing reference documents the contract.

The HTTP regression is adapted from the posted fixture and covers the old provider both on and off, with streaming and non-streaming probes. It checks the requested model reaches the local backend and that the saved pick remains unchanged; a title control still follows the session pick. On the old product code the streaming cases fail with the same stale-provider 404 (off) and an attempted connection to that provider (on, 502). Fixed Desktop/ClaudeDesktop/HasTools tests pass under `-race -count=5`.

At this exact head, all seven acceptance commands passed with Go1.26.8, isolated HOME and pinned caches: native Linux vet/build, Linux nogui vet/build, Windows vet/build, and `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m` (69 packages). Gofmt and whitespace checks are clean.

Reproduced the stale-provider part of this issue on macOS with packaged Magpie 0.1.1296 and Claude Desktop 2.42304.2.

In this case provider A was still enabled globally, but Claude Desktop had been restricted to provider B. `GET /v1/models` correctly listed only B. `claude-desktop.model` still contained an A model, and the Desktop startup probe for B's Haiku alias was sent to A's Opus model. The returned 502 named A. The gateway usage record confirmed `req=B/claude-haiku-5-5`, `provider=A`, `model=claude-opus-5-5`.

The caller was Claude Desktop and the probe body was:

```json
{"model":"<B's Haiku alias>","max_tokens":1,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"."}]}
```

So validation against the globally enabled providers alone is not sufficient: a cached pick can also be outside the current Desktop-visible catalog. An explicit connection probe should retain its selected provider/model and should not mutate the session's pick. This supports the positive title-prompt identification fix proposed above.

Separately, this environment also has a credential-specific upstream refusal of raw HTTP probes. Replaying that same minimal request directly to the configured upstream, bypassing Magpie, returns 429, while a genuine Claude Code invocation through the identical proxy and credential succeeds. That is a separate compatibility problem, not evidence that the stale-provider routing fix failed. No credentials, prompts from real work, proxy authentication details, or account identifiers are included here.

Gentle nudge on this one — no rush. The fix (branch `hunt30-desktop-title`, head 910522a7) still applies cleanly to current main. Since it was posted, SivanCola reproduced the stale-provider half of the report on macOS with packaged Magpie 0.1.1296 and Claude Desktop 2.42304.2, which lands right on the behavior this addresses: the title probe went to a provider a previous session had left behind instead of the model it was asked about, so `desktopTurn` now recognizes the title prompt by its shape instead of trusting `max_tokens`. Happy to adjust if anything is missing.

issue.body:
### 环境信息
- **MaGpie 版本**：`v0.1.1318` (macOS arm64)
- **客户端**：Claude Desktop（含内置 Code tab）

### 问题描述
当为 `claude-desktop` 显式配置了 `haiku` 档位（例如通过 `magpie claude-desktop haiku zenmux/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5` 写入 `claude-desktop.tiers.json`），且用户在 Claude Desktop 主会话中选择了一个较慢的推理模型（例如 `opencode-go/gemini-4-argon-contributor`，记录在 `claude-desktop.model`）工作时：

Claude Desktop 在后台自动发起的无工具短请求（如自动生成会话标题 `You write short session titles.` 或 fork 会话辅助请求），虽然请求进来时已解析为配置的 `haiku` 档位模型 `zenmux/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5`，但网关在路由时**仍然将其覆盖为了 `claude-desktop.model` 中的主会话模型**（如 `opencode-go/gemini-4-argon-contributor`）。

由于重型推理模型的首字延迟（TTFT 常在 15s～40s）超过了 Claude Desktop 对后台标题请求的客户端固定超时（15s / 30s），导致这类后台请求频繁触发客户端超时断开（`status: 499, "error": "the agent canceled the request"`）。

### 复现步骤
1. 设置 Claude Desktop 的 `haiku` 档位为包含 `claude`/`haiku`/`anthropic` 字样的第三方供应商模型：
   ```bash
   magpie claude-desktop haiku zenmux/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5
   ```
   此时 `claude-desktop.tiers.json` 为：
   ```json
   {
     "fable": "zenmux/anthropic/claude-fable-5.1",
     "haiku": "zenmux/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5",
     "opus": "zenmux/anthropic/claude-opus-5.5",
     "sonnet": "zenmux/anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5"
   }
   ```
   `/v1/models` 中该模型也正常带上了 `"anthropic_family_tier": "haiku", "is_family_default": true`。
2. 在 Claude Desktop 主对话中选择 `opencode-go/gemini-4-argon-contributor` 进行正常带工具的对话（此时 `~/.config/magpie/claude-desktop.model` 被更新为 `opencode-go/gemini-4-argon-contributor`）。
3. 当 Claude Desktop 触发后台无 `tools` 的标题生成或轻量辅助请求时，查看 `~/.config/magpie/routing/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl`。

### 实际路由日志表现（脱敏）
在路由日志中可以看到，请求的 `model` 字段虽然是 `zenmux/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5`，但实际路由的 `provider` 和 `tries` 却被替换成了 `claude-desktop.model` 里记录的 `opencode-go/gemini-4-argon-contributor`，并在 15s / 30s 整点触发 499：

```json
{
  "agent": "claude-desktop",
  "model": "zenmux/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5",
  "provider": "opencode-go",
  "tries": [
    {
      "id": "opencode-go#xxx",
      "model": "gemini-4-argon-contributor",
      "done": true,
      "status": 499,
      "ms": 15000,
      "fail": "canceled",
      "error": "the agent canceled the request"
    }
  ],
  "done": true,
  "status": 499,
  "error": "the agent canceled the request",
  "ms": 15000,
  "prompt": {
    "tokens": 540,
    "turns": 1,
    "parts": [
      {"kind": "system", "tokens": 22},
      {"kind": "chat", "tokens": 518}
    ]
  }
}
```

### 临时绕过验证（可定位原因）
如果新建一个**名称不含 `claude` / `haiku` / `anthropic` 等关键字**的路由组（例如 `group/zm-fast`，组内唯一成员仍为 `zenmux/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5`），并将 `haiku` 档位指向该路由组：
```bash
magpie group add zm-fast models=zenmux/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5
magpie claude-desktop haiku group/zm-fast
```
再次发送完全相同的无工具标题请求（`system: "You write short session titles."`），就不会被 `claude-desktop.model` 覆盖，而是正常路由到 `zenmux` 的 `anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5` 并在 1.7s 内返回 `200`。

### 期望行为
当 `claude-desktop` 的短请求/标题请求所请求的模型**已经是用户在 `claude-desktop.tiers.json` 中显式配置的档位模型**（或已经是明确带 `provider/` 前缀的已服务模型）时，应当直接按该档位模型路由，不再用 `claude-desktop.model` 中的主会话模型将其覆盖。

Published a fix in my fork: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/9fd7a9d4c087d3c0f4caac1ff3d27a8350577744

Thanks to @ggbdpq for the diagnosis and posted fix above, credited as co-author. Desktop titles now use the existing positive system-prompt check (`desktopTitle`) for both Electron and Claude Code. A small max_tokens alone no longer reroutes a credential probe to the saved session model. The unused client-kind argument is removed from desktopTurn and all callers, and the routing reference documents the contract.

The HTTP regression is adapted from the posted fixture and covers the old provider both on and off, with streaming and non-streaming probes. It checks the requested model reaches the local backend and that the saved pick remains unchanged; a title control still follows the session pick. On the old product code the streaming cases fail with the same stale-provider 404 (off) and an attempted connection to that provider (on, 502). Fixed Desktop/ClaudeDesktop/HasTools tests pass under `-race -count=5`.

At this exact head, all seven acceptance commands passed with Go1.26.8, isolated HOME and pinned caches: native Linux vet/build, Linux nogui vet/build, Windows vet/build, and `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m` (69 packages). Gofmt and whitespace checks are clean.

Combined branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/issue-batch-20261023-t

Not checked: real Claude Desktop's credential dialog, a live provider, macOS/Windows runtime, or the Desktop-visible-catalog restriction itself. The fixture uses the reported probe shape and existing test backend; it does not simulate the separate upstream raw-probe refusal. No live gateway/config changed and no upstream PR opened.

Verified — `9fd7a9d4` applies clean (`git apply --3way --check`) to current main (`e00fbdbb`, checked 2026-10-23; its merge-base `63be4771` took a 444-commit wave in between without touching the site), with the exact trailer `Co-authored-by: ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>` in the commit message. The product change is my 910522a7's: the title line `title := !tools && desktopTitle(body) && desktopAccepts(asked)` and the `byClaudeCode` removal (signature and call site) are byte-identical to mine, with the comments shortened but the same facts; `small` is rightly kept for `observe.go`, and `fromClaudeCode`'s three other callers are untouched. The regression adapts my fixture and extends it from one case to four — old provider off/on, streaming and non-streaming — keeping the pick-file-stays assertions and the real-title control, plus a docs bullet and a fixture touch-up that keeps an existing title case on the title path.

With `desktop.go` and `gateway.go` reverted to tip and the new test kept, all four cases fail with the report's shapes, and pass with the fix back:

```
probe: 404 {"error":{"message":"Any is switched off in Magpie, so \"fake/claude-sonnet-5\" is not served; switch it on again in Magpie's Providers to use it",...}}
probe: 502 {"error":{"message":"Any: Post \"http://127.0.0.1:1/v1/messages\": dial tcp 127.0.0.1:1: connectex: No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it.",...}}
```

— the 404 is the report's own error; the 502 is the stale-provider connection attempt SivanCola reproduced on macOS. The Desktop family around it (`TestDesktop*`, `TestClaudeDesktop*`, `TestHasTools`): `ok`. `gofmt -l` clean, `go vet -tags nogui ./internal/gateway` clean. I could not run `-race` here (no C toolchain on this Windows box), so that stays on your recorded run.

One cross-check on my #3264 patch (`b55cf300`, tier picks): the two fixes edit the same line, and neither eats the other. #2473 changes what identifies a title (prompt shape instead of max_tokens); #3264 exempts tier picks from titlehood (`&& !desktopTierAsked(asked)`). Applying `b55cf300` on top of this commit conflicts only on that expected shared line; resolved they read `title := !tools && desktopTitle(body) && desktopAccepts(asked) && !desktopTierAsked(asked)` — a tier pick goes as asked, a real title still follows the session. Either variant of #2473 can land and #3264 stays needed and independent on top.

Thanks for the credit, and for covering the on/off and streaming halves my fixture didn't.

issue.title: Claude Desktop gateway probe refused on a model the key was never asked for; 403 message names the sent model, not the one checked

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### Environment

- magpie `v0.1.1964`, gateway mode (`magpie web --gateway` in a container), with Gateway-page key model restrictions in use. `internal/gateway/desktop.go` and `internal/gateway/key_models.go` on `main` show the same code paths.
- Client: Claude Desktop 2.7032 via CC Switch "model mapping" (its local proxy rewrites the model before forwarding). The bug reproduces with plain curl — CC Switch is not needed.

### Summary

For `agent=claude-desktop`, magpie rewrites requests **before** the key-model check (`desktopTurn`):

- the gateway probe (`max_tokens:1`, a single `.` user message) is served on `desktopDefault` — the **first entry of the claude-desktop model list** — never on the model the probe named;
- any small tool-less request for a claude-looking model, and any request for an unserved model, is likewise rewritten (to the session pick, else the first listed).

When that first entry is a **routing group** (our list led with the found group `auto/glm-5-turbo`, members `prov-a/glm-5-turbo` + `prov-b/glm-5-turbo`) and the calling key holds to models that do not cover **every** member, the check refuses with 403 — but `keyModelError` prints `call.Model` (the model the client **sent**), not the rewritten `asked` that actually failed. The result is a self-contradictory message: it refuses a model the key is explicitly allowed, and the same model on any non-desktop agent returns 200.

### Repro (curl only, sanitized)

Setup: two enabled providers serve the same model name `glm-5-turbo`, so the found group `auto/glm-5-turbo` exists and is the first entry of the claude-desktop list. Gateway key `mykey` is held to `prov-a/*` only.

1. The probe, exactly as Desktop's gateway check sends it (the model string is ignored):

```sh
curl -s https://magpie.example/v1/messages \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MYKEY" \
  -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Claude/2.7032.0 Chrome/132.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
  -d '{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5","max_tokens":1,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"."}]}'
```

→ 403 `{"error":{"message":"The gateway key \"mykey\" may not use claude-haiku-4-5; it may use prov-a/*. Change the key's models in magpie's Gateway page, or use a model it has.","type":"permission_error"},...}` — naming the **sent** model, while the check actually failed on `group/auto-glm-5-turbo`.

2. Ask for the rewritten target directly:

```sh
… -d '{"model":"auto/glm-5-turbo","max_tokens":1,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"."}]}'
```

→ 403 `may not use group/auto-glm-5-turbo` — the correct target, which shows step 1's message names the wrong thing.

3. Same probe with an unrestricted key → 200, reply `"model":"glm-5-turbo"` — confirming the probe is served by the first-listed group, not the requested model.

4. A model the key does hold (e.g. `prov-a/<model>`), sent without the Claude Desktop UA → 200. Only `agent=claude-desktop` is affected.

### Observed impact

- Desktop's sign-in / Test-connection fails ("Couldn't sign in to Gateway") even though the mapped session model works and normal chat turns succeed; the probe result and real usability diverge.
- The usage log records the refusal under the sent model (`model` = `req` = the CC-Switch-mapped id, `err="model not allowed for the gateway key"`), which sends debugging toward the wrong model.

### Expected

- `keyModelError` should name the `asked` that was actually checked (the rewritten model or the group ref), not `call.Model`.
- Consider whether the probe — and small rewritten requests — should fall back to a model the key may use before failing: when the first listed entry is a multi-provider group, a restricted key fails its sign-in check regardless of what it is allowed.

### Workaround

Add the missing provider wildcard (`prov-b/*`) to the key — or name the group (`auto/glm-5-turbo`): naming a group passes `groupAllowed` without having to cover every member's provider.

Related: #2473 (the credentials test also lands somewhere the caller did not ask for).

issue.title: Claude Desktop startup check forwards the probe upstream: 20 s delay when the model is slow

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### What happens

On every Claude Desktop start (3P gateway mode) the connection check costs about 20 s when the chosen/default model is slow:

[custom-3p:health] test request timed out but the host answers
[custom-3p:health] unreachable; retrying once ... aborted due to timeout

Desktop aborts after ~10 s, retries once, then reports not_testable. magpie logs the same request as a real call:

gateway: claude-desktop's call to auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 on happy failed: 499 after 9.983s: the agent canceled the request

### Cause

magpie already recognises the check (desktopProbe in internal/gateway/desktop.go): max_tokens=1, no system/tools, a single "." message. It then reroutes it to the menu/default model and forwards it upstream with 16 tokens. Desktop only reads whether it was answered, so the upstream latency is pure startup delay.

### Suggestion

Answer desktopProbe locally with a canned Anthropic message (content ".", stop_reason end_turn) instead of forwarding, or add a setting to pick a fast model for connection checks.

### Environment

magpie 0.1.3076, CachyOS Linux, Claude Desktop 4.23118.0-3 (AUR), 3P gateway at 127.0.0.13425, model auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.

Related #2473 (check misrouted to a closed provider), #4175 (probe 403).

### Workaround

A tiny local proxy in front of the gateway answers the probe and forwards everything else; inferenceGatewayBaseUrl points at it.
